claim_text: The accepted partition assigns Spellweaver's Run to Traversal and exploration.
interpretation: Accepted cohort assignment; not a mechanic claim.

claim_text: The accepted identity ledger records canonical identity catalog/spellweavers-run.
interpretation: The accepted identity is catalog-based and records no route.

claim_text: The role-base catalog lists spellweavers-run in unroutableGameIds.
interpretation: At the role base, catalog presentation intentionally withholds a launch route.

claim_text: The role-base catalog literal has id spellweavers-run, title Spellweaver's Run, cover /games/cover/cover-spellweavers-run.png, no href property, and raw status playable.
interpretation: These are literal catalog fields before unroutable normalization; description prose is not implementation evidence.

claim_text: The role-base gameCards export rewrites unroutable cards to href undefined and status coming-soon.
interpretation: Spellweaver's Run is emitted without a launch route because SW-CUR-001 proves membership in this set.

claim_text: The accepted-baseline E2E test navigates to the helper-provided URL, clicks Begin the Run, and expects a canvas.
interpretation: This is retained test intent, not a successful browser observation and not proof of movement.

claim_text: The retained E2E gameplay test contains no movement, lane-input, completion, responsive-profile, console, or network assertion after the canvas becomes visible.
interpretation: The exact test body establishes only its limited assertion surface.

claim_text: The accepted historical denominator classifies seven spellweavers-run cartridge files at revision 1a21fb9 as deleted.
interpretation: The cartridge source is reachable historical evidence, not current implementation evidence.

claim_text: The accepted historical denominator classifies the legacy spellweavers-run page at revision 4106ba3 as deleted.
interpretation: The page is reachable historical evidence only.

claim_text: The accepted historical denominator classifies the legacy SpellweaversRunGame component at revision 4106ba3 as deleted.
interpretation: The component is reachable historical evidence only.

claim_text: The accepted historical denominator classifies the legacy spellweaversRun logic and config files at revision 4106ba3 as deleted.
interpretation: The legacy model and config are reachable historical evidence only.

claim_text: The legacy model defines statuses start, playing, victory, and defeat.
interpretation: Historical state vocabulary; no current state is inferred.

claim_text: The legacy state stores difficulty, mana, score, combo, collected words, target index, orbs, current sentence, words, answer counters, completed sentences, game time, and spawn timer.
interpretation: Historical state fields.

claim_text: Legacy lane selection maps RNG below 0.33 to left, below 0.66 to center, and all remaining values to right.
interpretation: Historical lane assignment; this is not player-avatar movement.

claim_text: A legacy orb is created for a sentence word in one lane at y equal to half the configured scrollHeight.
interpretation: Historical orb spawn position.

claim_text: Each legacy tick increases every orb y by scrollSpeed/1000 multiplied by deltaMs.
interpretation: Historical downward orb motion is the only explicit position update in this range.

claim_text: Legacy ticks remove orbs whose y exceeds GAME_HEIGHT plus collectionZoneHeight.
interpretation: Historical off-board culling boundary.

claim_text: When the legacy spawn timer reaches the difficulty interval, the first word index not represented by an orb is spawned and the timer resets to zero.
interpretation: Historical timed spawn transition.

claim_text: Legacy collection searches the selected lane for the first uncollected orb whose y lies from GAME_HEIGHT minus collectionZoneHeight through GAME_HEIGHT.
interpretation: Historical lane-and-zone hit predicate; no physics-body collision is used in this function.

claim_text: A correct legacy collection removes the orb, appends its word, advances target index and combo, increments score and counters, and changes status to victory after the last word.
interpretation: Historical correct-collection state transition.

claim_text: An incorrect legacy collection removes the orb, subtracts 20 configured mana without going below zero, resets combo, increments attempts, and defeats at zero mana.
interpretation: Historical incorrect-collection state transition.

claim_text: The legacy logical gameplay surface is 390 by 600 with three lanes, an 80-pixel collection zone, and a 60-pixel scroll header.
interpretation: Historical fixed logical world geometry.

claim_text: Legacy difficulty config sets scroll speeds to 60, 90, 120, and 150 pixels per second and spawn intervals to 2000, 1500, 1000, and 500 milliseconds for easy, normal, hard, and extreme.
interpretation: Historical per-difficulty motion timing.

claim_text: The legacy component observes its container dimensions with ResizeObserver and also polls dimensions every 200 milliseconds for at most two seconds.
interpretation: Historical responsive measurement mechanism.

claim_text: Entering the legacy playing phase requests fullscreen, runs requestAnimationFrame, clamps each frame delta to 50 milliseconds, and ticks the game state.
interpretation: Historical start-to-play runtime transition and timing.

claim_text: Legacy victory or defeat computes accuracy and XP, stores results, and changes the component phase to ended.
interpretation: Historical terminal transition.

claim_text: Legacy scale is the smaller of container width divided by 390 and container height divided by 600.
interpretation: Historical uniform fit scaling; no named compact/wide profile appears in this calculation.

claim_text: Legacy pointer or touch input converts clientX to logical gameX, divides by lane width, clamps the lane index to zero through two, and invokes that lane.
interpretation: Historical horizontal lane-selection input.

claim_text: Legacy keyboard input maps ArrowLeft or A to left lane, ArrowDown or S to center lane, and ArrowRight or D to right lane while playing.
interpretation: Historical keyboard lane-selection input.

claim_text: The legacy container uses height 75vh and full width, switching at md to aspect-video and automatic height; active play also sets minHeight 400px.
interpretation: Historical CSS composition rules, not browser-observed profile behavior.

claim_text: The active legacy container retains height 75vh and full width, switches at md to aspect-video and automatic height, and binds click plus touchstart.
interpretation: Historical active-container responsive and input bindings.

claim_text: The legacy Stage uses measured container width and height while a child Group applies the uniform logical scale to a 390-by-600 background anchored at zero,zero.
interpretation: Historical viewport-to-world projection; no camera follow transform is present in this cited projection.

claim_text: The legacy renderer draws three equal lane rectangles below the scroll and above the collection zone.
interpretation: Historical lane topology.

claim_text: The legacy renderer clips orb groups to the lane and collection region and renders each orb with Circle and Text primitives.
interpretation: Historical concrete orb rendering uses generated shapes/text in this range, not a physical orb image.

claim_text: The legacy renderer draws the collection zone from y 520 through y 600 across the full 390-pixel logical width.
interpretation: Historical collection-zone geometry derived directly from GAME_HEIGHT 600 and zone height 80.

claim_text: The legacy HUD renders a mana bar, Mana text, Score text, and Combo text within the logical surface.
interpretation: Historical simultaneously visible HUD elements.

claim_text: The legacy end screen selects victory or defeat text, reports score, XP, accuracy and custom counts, restarts to start, and exits to /student/games.
interpretation: Historical result and exit transitions.

claim_text: The withdrawn cartridge snapshot declares semantic slots for world background, hero, correct and incorrect targets and feedback, UI panel, lane marker, word orb, collection zone, and mana effect.
interpretation: Reachable historical cartridge declaration only; it does not prove physical asset binding or current use.

claim_text: The withdrawn cartridge snapshot maps the lower 75 percent of normalized pointer space into three equal horizontal input regions.
interpretation: Reachable historical cartridge pointer-region bindings.

claim_text: The withdrawn cartridge snapshot declares a fixed Phaser configuration of 960 by 540.
interpretation: Reachable historical cartridge logical surface; host scaling is outside this file range.

claim_text: The withdrawn cartridge scene uses world.background at 960 by 540 when the texture exists and otherwise renders a full-surface rectangle.
interpretation: Reachable historical semantic asset usage with an explicit fallback.

claim_text: The withdrawn cartridge renderer positions the one active orb at x 160 plus lane times 320 and y equal to model.orb.position.
interpretation: Reachable historical projection of lane and scroll position.

claim_text: The withdrawn cartridge update resolves input actions only after confirming a nonzero canvas surface and advances movement by delta multiplied by edition speed tuning.
interpretation: Reachable historical update/input order; no current behavior inferred.

claim_text: A missed crossing in the withdrawn cartridge subtracts 10 mana, resets combo, subtracts 10 score, increments attempts, respawns the same target, and defeats at zero mana.
interpretation: Reachable historical missed-orb transition.

claim_text: The withdrawn cartridge ignores lane selections outside integer lanes zero through two and ignores selections before position 380 or after position 450.
interpretation: Reachable historical lane and collection-zone gate.

claim_text: A correct lane in the withdrawn cartridge increments combo and answers, adds 100 plus prior combo times 25 score, advances the word, advances sentences in order, and finishes victory after all sentences.
interpretation: Reachable historical correct-sequence transition.

claim_text: The accepted asset denominator records spellweavers-run-gameplay.png as a 390-by-844 PNG of 24,623 bytes with SHA-256 05e9d81f811e1bc000f042618311c7e3ee6d158be73e954d18a13c6868e33bdd.
interpretation: A captured image candidate; screenshots do not prove movement or transitions.

claim_text: The accepted asset denominator records spellweavers-run-action.mp3 as a 5,832,505-byte MPEG audio file with SHA-256 d9c3c6b425e40eeb5c167d47832aa979833ff1cb632d58b040043d8479cf238c.
interpretation: The denominator proves the binary candidate exists; source-backed runtime usage is unavailable.

claim_text: Spellweaver's Run has a moving player avatar, camera follow, obstacles, and collision hazards because its title calls it a runner.
interpretation: Reject title/catalog analogy; exact historical code shows lane-selected falling orbs, and current implementation evidence is unavailable.

claim_text: The archived design spec and gameplay screenshot prove the current compact and wide responsive transitions.
interpretation: Reject design-prose and screenshot substitution; no browser audit was performed and screenshots do not prove profile transitions.

claim_text: Every spellweavers-run-named PNG or MP3 is loaded during gameplay.
interpretation: Reject slug-only asset-role assignment; only the cover has a current source binding, while screenshot/audio runtime usage is not source-proven.
